card.name: The digit 9 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 9 (occasionally a hyphen) in the middle of a longer number, such as a DOI, ISSN, phone number, date or decimal dose. It rarely fires on a 9 that starts a number on its own.

modes.label: 9 in identifiers
modes.description: A 9 inside DOIs, ISSNs and phone numbers.

modes.label: 9 in doses and decimals
modes.description: A 9 inside a decimal or dose figure with units.

modes.label: 9 in dates
modes.description: A 9 in the middle of a numeric date.

card.plain: It lights up on the digit 9 when it sits inside a longer number such as a phone number, code or dose.
